statement: Board 34 (arc-vocab) added 13 primitives and 10 fallback learners to capability/grid-dsl.mjs, read off 15 families of unsolved TRAINING tasks (notes/grid-vocab.md). The primitives are late words: registered by name but kept out of PRIMS, so the counted vocabulary (PRIMS plus LEARNERS) stays 196 and the search meets them through the fallback learner lateWord; the fallback learners went from 1 to 11, each run on the task's input only, its answer taken inside the clock. A task counts as solved here only when a right attempt was stamped at or under 3000 ms. The training control (in sample, 100 tasks, seed 33) went 41 to 45 (gained 4, lost 0). The held out evaluation split at 3000 ms with 2 attempts went 86 to 94 of 400 (gained 8, lost 0); timed out 279, found but wrong 26, exhausted 1, mean 2786.95 ms; attempts with an added word 9 right and 0 wrong, 0 of them stamped past the clock. Against the control arm bench/verdicts/grid-split-evaluation-control.json (the search without the fallback phase (--fixed-vocab), one attempt, the vocabulary before Board 23, 71 solved) this run gained 23 and lost 0. This is the bar run, and the bar (at least 96 of 400 inside the clock, at most 3 lost, the training control losing at most 2) is NOT MET. Contaminated as bench/verdicts/grid-attempts.json was: 1 of the 400 scored evaluation tasks shares a pair with a development task (070dd51e is pair for pair identical to training 40853293), so its score is in sample; the other scored tasks share no train or test pair with the development tasks; without 070dd51e this run solves 93 of 399. This is the third run of this item's words on the evaluation split (the builder's, the verify plane's, this fix pass's); the fix was decided from the verify plane's findings and the training split, and no evaluation task was opened. Latencies were measured on a machine shared with other builders.
